lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
The velvet curtains hide the city light,
He sips his coffee in the hollow night,
A tattered fedora rests upon the chair,
While shadows dance in the smoky air.
[Pre-Chorus]
One clue remains to solve the crime,
He’s chasing shadows in the halls of time.
[Chorus]
Under the glow of the neon sign,
He traces the truth on a jagged line,
In a city that never sleeps at all,
He catches the secrets before they fall.
[Verse]
A rainy street reflects the yellow glow,
He follows footsteps where the strangers go,
A whispered secret, a heavy heavy door,
He finds the pieces on the dusty floor.
[Pre-Chorus]
One clue remains to solve the crime,
He’s chasing shadows in the halls of time.
[Chorus]
Under the glow of the neon sign,
He traces the truth on a jagged line,
In a city that never sleeps at all,
He catches the secrets before they fall.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The brass begins to wail and cry,
Under the gaze of a midnight sky.
[Chorus]
Under the glow of the neon sign,
He traces the truth on a jagged line,
In a city that never sleeps at all,
He catches the secrets before they fall.
[Outro]
